# Checkpoint

Issue resolved: OIDC session domain normalization, localhost cookies, and callback URL slash handling.

Changes:
- `AuthenticationConfig.validate` normalizes nonempty session domains through `getHostname`, which prepends `http://` when needed, parses with `url.Parse`, and returns `Hostname()`; parse errors propagate.
- OIDC state and token cookies omit the Domain attribute for localhost. State cookie retains the provider callback path.
- `callbackURL` removes one trailing slash before appending the callback path.
- Added focused tests for normalization, parse errors, cookie attributes, and callback URLs.

Verification:
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./internal/config ./internal/server/auth/method/oidc` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestAuthenticationSessionDomainNormalization(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		input, want string
+	}{
+		{"http://localhost:8080", "localhost"},
+		{"https://auth.example.com:8443", "auth.example.com"},
+		{"auth.example.com:8080", "auth.example.com"},
+		{"localhost", "localhost"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.input, func(t *testing.T) {
+			cfg := AuthenticationConfig{
+				Session: AuthenticationSession{Domain: tc.input},
+				Methods: AuthenticationMethods{OIDC: AuthenticationMethod[AuthenticationMethodOIDCConfig]{Enabled: true}},
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+			require.Equal(t, tc.want, cfg.Session.Domain)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAuthenticationSessionDomainParseError(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := AuthenticationConfig{
+		Session: AuthenticationSession{Domain: "http://%"},
+		Methods: AuthenticationMethods{OIDC: AuthenticationMethod[AuthenticationMethodOIDCConfig]{Enabled: true}},
+	}
+	require.Error(t, cfg.validate())
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+package oidc
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestCallbackURLTrailingSlash(t *testing.T) {
+	require.Equal(t, "http://localhost:8080/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/callback", callbackURL("http://localhost:8080/", "google"))
+	require.Equal(t, "https://example.com/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/callback", callbackURL("https://example.com", "google"))
+	require.Equal(t, "https://example.com//auth/v1/method/oidc/google/callback", callbackURL("https://example.com//", "google"))
+}
+
+func TestLocalhostOIDCCookies(t *testing.T) {
+	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "localhost", StateLifetime: time.Minute, TokenLifetime: time.Hour})
+	path := "/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/callback"
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	m.Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) {})).ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/authorize", nil))
+	cookies := w.Result().Cookies()
+	require.Len(t, cookies, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, stateCookieKey, cookies[0].Name)
+	require.Equal(t, "", cookies[0].Domain)
+	require.Equal(t, path, cookies[0].Path)
+
+	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
+	require.NoError(t, m.ForwardResponseOption(context.Background(), w, &auth.CallbackResponse{ClientToken: "token"}))
+	cookies = w.Result().Cookies()
+	require.Len(t, cookies, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, tokenCookieKey, cookies[0].Name)
+	require.Equal(t, "", cookies[0].Domain)
+	require.Equal(t, "/", cookies[0].Path)
+}
+
+func TestStateCookieDomain(t *testing.T) {
+	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "example.com", StateLifetime: time.Minute})
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	m.Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) {})).ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/authorize", nil))
+	cookies := w.Result().Cookies()
+	require.Len(t, cookies, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, "example.com", cookies[0].Domain)
+	require.Equal(t, "/auth/v1/method/oidc/google/callback", cookies[0].Path)
+}
